detail: No capability_library, tool registry or reusable candidate store is exposed in this runtime; the mission workspace holds only sources/pilot-charter.txt, sources/weekly-observations.txt and sources/reviewer-note.txt, and the only granted tools are file_read, file_list, file_write and save_artifact, with no shell or Node execution channel. 'delegate' is inherently a host schedulerce capability: the approved criteria require the real Head/MissionManager delegation tree to launch distinct children in parallel and persist their bounded evidence notes as attributed artifacts. A local file-writing procedure cannot produce that; it would only fabricate delegation evidence and fail the risk clause that parallel recursion must be observed in the production tree rather than inferred. I therefore made no qualified local_target claim: no procedure source file could be authored, executed or SHA-256 probed here, so acquired is omitted. Open-source discovery over the network is barred by the immutable approved scope (No web/network) and could not have helped regardless, because installation and host configuration changes are prohibited and documentation alone is not accepted as proof. Determination is terminal; the cited brief cannot satisfy criterion 5 without the host registering a real delegate tool.
